Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi Vihara | Bodh Gaya | Sacred Buddhist Temple | Travel Vlog
Welcome to another episode of Chutti Hai! In this video, I take you to the serene and spiritually uplifting Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi Vihara in Bodh Gaya, Bihar – one of the most sacred Buddhist sites in India.
This beautiful Sri Lankan Buddhist temple is part of the Maha Bodhi Society of India and was established during the 2550th Buddha Jayanti celebrations. Every year, it hosts special ceremonies, relic exhibitions, and prayer gatherings that draw pilgrims and tourists from across the world.
